name: Dark Alley
desc1: This rancid alleyway is claustrophobic and unsettling. Trash is ankle-
desc2: deep on the ground, and occasionally something squishy and wet can be
desc3: felt underfoot. Bloodstains are frequent on the crumbling walls,
desc4: adding a certain je-ne-sais-quoi to this fine place. A fine, well-kept
desc5: mansion stands unexpectedly to the south. Its exquisite manufacture
desc6: is definitely at odds with the remainder of Rhudaur's buildings, and
desc7: it also emanates an aura of pure evil. The alley exits to the north.
